title: Peruvian Potatoes Causa Limena
description: A sweet and cozy Peruvian dish featuring mature cheddar and pickle, made dairy-free-friendly in a causa limena form, this recipe is a unique twist on traditional Peruvian cuisine, with a sweet and aerated texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mash the boiled potatoes in a large bowl with a fork until they are mostly smooth.
In a separate bowl, mix together the olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Add the oil mixture to the mashed potatoes and stir until well combined.
Stir in the dairy-free mature cheddar cheese until it is fully incorporated.
Add the pickle relish to the potato mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the potato mixture to a baking dish and top with additional dairy-free cheese if desired.
Bake the causa limena in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove the causa limena from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh cilantro.
Serve the causa limena hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
